description: Declares controls whose compliant state is the ABSENCE of configuration. Exception lists, bypass lists and runtime-flag checks are compliant when empty, so 'no policy value found' is a valid PASS for them and must not be audited as an unearned PASS. Everything not declared here follows the default rule: absence of a required policy is a finding.

absence_is_compliant.rationale: These policies exist to create exceptions to a security control. Configuring them weakens the baseline; leaving them unset is the hardened state.
